body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. Yourself or one adjacent willing ally becomes Rallied until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: The Rallied creature may move 1 unit toward the target.

rider.title: Authority - Example
rider.html: Spend this Authority when a Rallied creature within 3 units consumes Rallied on an attack against this target: ignore 1 point of the target's cover bonus for that attack.
